inputs.brief: A silent ~40 s showcase film for Claude Prompts MCP: a box arrives with a radiant gadget (raw capability) that overwhelms; a companion holds up a frame whose interior is someplace else; through it the human scaffolds one lit join at a time (category, prompt, chain, gate, framework, workspace); the trio settles. Audience: developers landing on the GitHub README; frame 0 is the poster. The bots are standardizing their own design process (D49), and this run is the trail. Clean slate on assets (D56): every object is mused from the board before it enters a shot.
inputs.constraints: ~40 s at 30 fps, 1280x720, silent, poster at frame 0; swangle renderer here, final render on the Windows host; drawn on twos, light on ones; one locked camera and one emitter per shot; no asset accepted as a first iteration.
